- [2023/02/22] George W. Bush used CPAC to build support for his 2000 presidential campaign, speaking there in the late 1990s and early 2000s.
- [2023/02/22] Mitt Romney addressed CPAC in 2007 and 2012, using it to build momentum for his presidential campaigns.
- [2023/02/22] Ted Cruz gained national attention with a CPAC speech in 2013, calling for the repeal of Obamacare, and later ran for president in 2016.
- [2023/02/22] Donald Trump frequently spoke at CPAC since the early 2010s, using it to build support for his 2016 presidential campaign.
